recognize_zh: 這是腹部電腦斷層（CT）橫切面，紅色箭頭指向左上腹後方體積很小的脾臟，代表脾萎縮；慢性移植物抗宿主病（chronic GVHD）可造成功能性無脾，血液抹片可見 Howell-Jolly 小體。
features: Axial contrast-enhanced CT of the upper abdomen at the level of the liver and upper pole of kidneys
Red arrow indicates a markedly small soft-tissue structure in the posterior left upper quadrant, consistent with an atrophic spleen
Normal-sized liver with enhancing vessels; aorta and vertebral body shown for orientation
No focal splenic mass is evident in this single slice
describe_en: This is not a morphologic image but an axial contrast-enhanced abdominal CT. The arrow marks a markedly small spleen in the posterior left upper quadrant, whereas the liver is normal in size. In a patient with chronic graft-versus-host disease, splenic atrophy correlates with functional hyposplenism, which is confirmed on blood film by Howell-Jolly bodies and carries an increased risk of infection with encapsulated organisms. Findings are consistent with splenic atrophy in chronic GVHD.
